# ReVanced Extended Magisk Module (mod by @ev3rlin)

![Telegram](https://t.me/ev3rlin_rvx)

![License](https://github.com/ev3rlin/ReVanced-Extended?tab=GPL-3.0-1-ov-file#readme)

![CI](https://github.com/ev3rlin/ReVanced-Extended/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

![Release date](https://github.com/ev3rlin/ReVanced-Extended/releases)

![Release version](https://github.com/ev3rlin/ReVanced-Extended/releases/latest)

---

📌 Patches List

| Patch / Application | YouTube RVX | YouTube Music RVX |

|----------------------|-------------|-------------------|

| Included patches | • Visual preferences icons for YouTube
• Return YouTube Username | • Visual preferences icons for YouTube Music
• Return YouTube Username
• Disable music video in album |

| Excluded patches | • Custom header for YouTube | • Custom header for YouTube Music |

| App name | YouTube RVX | YT Music RVX |

| App icon | Vanced Black | Vanced Black |

| Light Theme Background Color | #FFF9F9F9 | - |

🚀 Features

* Updated automatically with the latest supported versions of apps and anddea patches (stable version)

* Optimize APKs and modules for size

* Fully open-source and free to use

* Modules:

- recompile invalidated odex for faster usage

- receive updates from Magisk app

- do not break safetynet or trigger root detections

- handle installation of the correct version of the stock app and all that

- support Magisk and KernelSU

📝 Notes

* Root versions: use zygisk-detach to detach YouTube and YT Music from Play Store if you are using magisk modules

* Non-root versions: require MicroG-RE to work

🙏 Credits

j-hc for zygisk-detach and the ReVanced apps builder and some more technical stuff

Morphe for MicroG-RE

anddea for revanced-extended patches
